units.source_text: 他写完《某傻子的一生》之后，一个偶然，在某旧家具店看见了制成标本的天鹅。

en.t: After he had finished writing A Fool's Life, by chance he saw a stuffed swan in an old furniture shop.

units.source_text: 它伸长了颈立着，连发黄的羽毛也被虫蛀蚀了。

en.t: It stood with its neck stretched out, and even its yellowed feathers had been eaten away by insects.

units.source_text: 他回顾自己的一生，不禁热泪盈眶，冷笑出声。

en.t: Looking back over his own life, he could not help filling his eyes with hot tears and letting out a cold laugh.

units.source_text: 摆在他未来的不是发疯就是自杀。

en.t: What lay before him in the future was either madness or suicide.

units.source_text: 他一个人走在日落的街上，决心静静等待将他毁灭的命运的到来。

en.t: He walked alone through the sunset streets, resolved to wait quietly for the arrival of the fate that would destroy him.
